specification: Does the PV defect reported in the global knockout exist in the neuron-targeted model at the age and region where inhibition was recorded, and is it fewer cells, lower PV per cell, or neither?
decision_it_changes: Chooses between A1, A2/A3 and the physiological alternatives before any compound is chosen

specification: Synapsin-I-Cre with floxed Wwox, as in the electrophysiology paper; Cre-positive littermates, wild type and heterozygote kept as separate groups (heterozygote bursting 4 of 23 against 36 of 42 slices). The Rosa26 tdTomato reporter is present in the conditional models of the NB-4 source, so no new line is needed. A PV-Cre line is not proposed first: its recombination depends on the Pvalb program, so it cannot see cells that never switch it on
decision_it_changes: Avoids a new line; keeps the reading of recombination inside the same animals [Audit: the Rosa26 tdTomato reporter is stated only for the animals of the 2021 neuron-specific paper, not for the electrophysiology cohort; record the breeding direction (the Cre came with the male parent, which bears on germline recombination).]

specification: P14 and P17 (inside the viable window of 3 to 4 weeks); somatosensory cortex layer II/III and hippocampal CA1 and dentate gyrus, the two regions where currents and counts were obtained
decision_it_changes: Separates the cortex of the conditional model from the hippocampus of the global model [Audit: wording: currents were recorded only in neocortical layer II/III; hippocampal counts come from the global knockout; the conditional hippocampus showed no bursting; the paper never says 'somatosensory'.]

specification: PV protein; Pvalb mRNA; Gad1 mRNA and a second lineage marker (Lhx6 or SST) to define the GABAergic denominator; NeuN and nuclear density; Wwox read-out; tdTomato. Outputs per animal: density of Gad1-positive cells; fraction of them PV-positive and Pvalb-mRNA-positive; PV intensity per PV cell; tdTomato fraction in PV cells and in Gad1-positive cells; WWOX-negative fraction in PV cells
decision_it_changes: Gives the recombination read-out the NB-4 delta note asks for, beside number, identity and maturation

specification: The animal is the unit. Cell-level values are summarised per animal or analysed with animal as a random effect. Number per genotype and age fixed before reading (IPOTESI: at least the 7 per group of the earlier counts). Nuclei and sections are never replicates
decision_it_changes: Prevents the unit error seen in the currents (K7)

specification: Lineage density lower, PV fraction of lineage unchanged: A1 (fewer cells of the lineage) leads. Lineage density unchanged, PV fraction or PV intensity lower: A2 or A3 leads and a time course at P14 and P17 is read. Both unchanged: counts do not explain the currents, go to X8. tdTomato or WWOX-negative fraction low in PV cells: no cell-autonomous reading is possible, which does not forbid a functional probe
decision_it_changes: Decides whether a function-first probe (X8) or a counts-first reading continues [Audit: lacks a branch for lineage density lower and PV fraction lower together.]

specification: WFA and aggrecan (and Hapln1 if an antibody is validated) around lineage-positive cells, at the oldest viable age, with a wild-type control that shows nets at that age (R01). Net per PV cell is the endpoint, not total WFA. WFA alone is not read as functional integrity (R03)
decision_it_changes: If controls lack nets at P17 the arm is uninformative and is not read as absence of a link

specification: In slices from the neuron-targeted model, compare the effect on spontaneous bursting of a Kv3 positive modulator and of a GABA-A positive modulator, with identified fast-spiking recording where possible. Prediction fixed beforehand: a Kv3-sensitive deficit in identified cells predicts a larger effect of the first; a postsynaptic deficit with a known chloride gradient predicts the second; neither supports a clinical use. Excitatory-input modulators are not tested first (global excitation is not selective). No dose, schedule or regimen is stated here
decision_it_changes: Tests function without requiring cell-autonomy; carries the carbenoxolone caveat that slice pharmacology can be non-specific (earlier read of the same paper) [Audit: a GABA-A positive modulator will suppress bursting in almost any hyperexcitable slice and wild-type slices do not burst: the effect cannot separate a postsynaptic deficit from a nonspecific action.]

element: what would refute a WWOX-PNN link
specification: (a) net per PV cell not different between genotypes at an age where control nets are measurable, with an interval that excludes a pre-stated effect; (b) any WFA difference fully explained by PV cell number or PV level; (c) no difference in hyaluronan synthase, Hapln1 or aggrecan expression or protein; (d) manipulating the HYAL2-WWOX-SMAD4 axis in a neuronal system changes cell death or signalling but not the net. Absence of nets in a window where controls lack them refutes nothing
decision_it_changes: Stops the matrix lead from being carried on citation

specification: Re-clustering or tests with nuclei as replicates on the two pooled matrices; a new animal line; a requirement to run every experiment of the external report; any drug administration in animals
